steps.observation: You have 30 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Expand and prioritize low-carbon mobility  
   • Build dense, reliable public transit networks (electric buses, light rail)  
   • Add safe walking & cycling infrastructure to replace short car trips  
   • Encourage shared-mobility and electrification of taxis, ride-hails, and municipal fleets  

2. Decarbonize buildings and energy supply  
   • Tighten energy-efficiency standards; retrofit older buildings with insulation, heat pumps, smart controls  
   • Require all new developments to be net-zero or passive-house compliant  
   • Source electricity from local renewables (rooftop solar, district geothermal, waste-to-energy)

3. Implement smart urban planning and green infrastructure  
   • Zone for mixed-use, transit-oriented development to shorten commutes  
   • Increase urban green spaces and tree canopies that sequester CO₂ and reduce cooling demand  
   • Use data-driven traffic management and congestion pricing to cut vehicle idling and incentivize low-emission travel
